anomalies.observed: R34, the CAN0 termination resistor across the SW6 DIP switch, has value "120k" (120 kΩ). Its own description and MPN describe a 120Ω part (0603WAF1200T5E). The matching CAN1 termination R35 is "120R" (120 Ω).
anomalies.expected: A 120 Ω CAN bus termination matching R35 and the 120Ω part described for R34, so that CAN0 is properly terminated when the DIP switch is closed.

evidence.quote: (comp (ref "R34") (value "120k") ... (description " 100mW Thick Film Resistors 75V ±100ppm/℃ ±1% 120Ω 0603 Chip Resistor - Surface Mount ROHS")

anomalies.impact: With 120 kΩ in place of 120 Ω, CAN0 is effectively unterminated, causing signal reflections and reduced reliability on the Odrive CAN0 bus when the termination switch is enabled.

anomalies.observed: The net /LED_3.3V_POWER_SW connects only the anodes of D4, D14 and D23. No other component, switch or power pin is on this net, so nothing drives it.
anomalies.expected: The LED supply net should be driven from a source such as a switch or the 3.3V rail, so the status LEDs can light.
anomalies.impact: Three status LEDs would never light, although the rest of the design uses this supply for other LEDs.

anomalies.observed: R36 has value "24k", but its description and MPN (FRC0805J240TSD) describe a 24 Ω part.
anomalies.expected: Consistency between the value field and the part description. A 24.9k-class PoE signature resistor would be a plausible intended value, so the discrepancy may be only a labelling issue.

evidence.quote: (comp (ref "R36") (value "24k") ... (description " 125mW Thick Film Resistors 150V ±100ppm/℃ ±5% 24Ω 0805 Chip Resistor - Surface Mount ROHS")

anomalies.impact: If the 24 Ω part was really fitted, the PoE-style resistor across VOUTP/VOUTN would load the supply heavily.

parsed.summary: The strongest anomaly is R34, a CAN0 termination resistor whose value is 120 kΩ while its description and sibling R35 indicate 120 Ω, which leaves CAN0 unterminated. Two lower-confidence observations are an orphaned LED supply net and a 24k/24Ω value mismatch on R36.
